stories.title: Garcinol alleviates experimental colitis alongside microbiota and bile acid–FXR changes
stories.takeaway: A food-derived compound was associated with reduced colitis severity and changes in microbial and bile-acid signaling.
stories.what_happened: A November 20 npj Science of Food paper investigates garcinol in colitis models and reports changes in gut microbiota and bile acid–FXR signaling.
stories.why_it_matters: Connects intestinal inflammation, microbial ecology and host bile-acid sensing.
stories.caveat: Preclinical associations do not demonstrate efficacy in people or prove that microbiota changes mediate benefit.

stories.title: Probiotic encapsulation tested under simulated gastrointestinal stress
stories.takeaway: Water chestnut starch-based encapsulation was optimized to improve probiotic survival in simulated digestive conditions.
stories.what_happened: A November 20 Scientific Reports study evaluates starch-based formulations for protecting probiotics during laboratory gastrointestinal stress simulations.
stories.why_it_matters: Delivery stability is a practical barrier in translating live microbial products.
stories.caveat: Simulated digestion does not establish intestinal colonization, clinical delivery or therapeutic benefit.

stories.title: LMNA-mutant human iPSC cardiomyocytes show altered mechanosensing
stories.takeaway: Patient-relevant stem-cell-derived cardiac cells exhibit altered mechanical responsiveness and gene expression with a lamin A/C mutation.
stories.what_happened: A November 20 Scientific Reports paper examines mechanosensing and transcriptional changes in LMNA-mutant hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights the value of mechanically informed human cell models in disease research.
stories.caveat: In vitro phenotypes do not capture full cardiac physiology or establish treatment efficacy.

stories.title: Multi-omics study links gut microbiota and inflammatory metabolism to developmental delay
stories.takeaway: Integrated molecular profiles identify an inflammatory microbiota–metabolite signature associated with global developmental delay.
stories.what_happened: A November 20 Translational Psychiatry paper uses integrated multi-omics to investigate microbial and metabolic differences in developmental delay.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates the promise and interpretation challenges of microbiome–metabolome studies beyond intestinal disease.
stories.caveat: Associations cannot establish causality, and confounding and independent validation remain important.

stories.title: Phages may reshape bacterial fitness beyond direct killing
stories.takeaway: A new perspective contrasts lytic-phage resistance trade-offs with prophage-driven regulation of host-associated bacterial traits.
stories.what_happened: A November 20 npj Biofilms and Microbiomes comment synthesizes ways phages may alter colonization, virulence and host interactions.
stories.why_it_matters: Offers a conceptual framework for studying phage–bacteria ecology in host-associated microbial communities.
stories.caveat: This is a commentary rather than new experimental evidence; effects are context-dependent.
